lines.text: در حین غروب بخلاف بعضی سیارات که گاه باشد که این دو امر در ایشان بعکس فیما شو
lines.en: at the time of setting, unlike some planets where sometimes these two matters are reversed in them.

lines.text: کما عرف فیما سبق اما رؤیت هلال بعرف اهل نجوم عبارتست از رؤیت قمر در شب
lines.en: As was known in what preceded. But the sighting of the crescent, in the custom of the astronomers, is the expression for the sighting of the moon at night

lines.text: اوّل ماه و تحقیق ماهیت اینجاست که قمر جرمیت کثیف صیقلی پس از افتاب کسب نور
lines.en: of the first of the month. And the investigation of the essence is here, that the moon is a dense, polished body, so it acquires light from the sun

lines.text: کند و بجهة صقالت نور از او منعکس شود بر سطح ارض افتد و انرا قمر گویند و چون هر دو نیر کری
lines.en: and due to its polish, light is reflected from it and falls on the surface of the earth, and they call it the moon. And since both luminaries are spherical

lines.text: الشکلند چنانکه در ابعاد و اجرام مبین شده جرم شمس اعظم از جرم قمر و آینه نصف بیشتر از کره
lines.en: in shape, as has been explained in [the science of] distances and bodies, the body of the sun is greater than the body of the moon, and its mirror is more than half of the sphere

lines.text: قمر مستضیء شود بضیاء افتاب و نصف کمتر مظلم بحالت اصلی خود و فصل مشترک میان منیر و غیر
lines.en: of the moon is illuminated by the light of the sun, and less than half is dark in its original state. And the common section between the illuminated and the non-

lines.text: منیر از جرم قمر دایره بود چنانکه در مخروطی حکیم در کتاب مرجی التبرین مبرهن ساخته است
lines.en: illuminated of the body of the moon is a circle, as the wise [author] of the Conics has demonstrated in the book Marji' al-Tabrin.

lines.text: و انرا دایره ضیاء ظلام گویند و مخروط شعاع بصر در حین مشاهده چون محیط کره قمر شود
lines.en: And they call it the circle of light and darkness. And the cone of the visual ray at the time of observation, when it encompasses the sphere of the moon,

lines.text: مماس نصف کمتر از قمر شود انرا نصف مرئی گویند و نصف بیشتر را که مماس نتواند شد غیر
lines.en: touches less than half of the moon, they call it the visible half, and the more than half which it cannot touch, the non-

lines.text: مرئی و فصل مشترک میان مرئی و غیر مرئی از جرم قمر دایره بود که انرا دایره رؤیت
lines.en: visible. And the common boundary between the visible and the non-visible of the body of the moon is a circle, which they call the circle of vision.

lines.text: خوانند و اینها همه در کتاب مناظر اقلیدس به برهان معلوم شده است و ایندو دایره
lines.en: And all these have been made known by proof in the book of Optics of Euclid. And these two circles

lines.text: بحسب اختلاف ابعاد نیرین بصغیر و کبیر مختلف شوند و از وقت اجتماع قطعه ظلمانی ماه بجانب
lines.en: differ in smallness and greatness according to the difference in the distances of the two luminaries. And from the time of conjunction, the dark segment of the moon is towards

lines.text: ارض بود و نورانی بجانب افتاب در اینحال دایرتین منطبق باشد بر یکدیگر یا متوازی
lines.en: the earth, and the illuminated [segment] is towards the sun. In this state, the two circles are coincident with each other or parallel

lines.text: تقریبا و چون اجتماع زایل شود هر اینه هر دو دایره مقاطع یکدیگر شوند قطعه نورانی بجانب
lines.en: approximately. And when the conjunction ceases, necessarily both circles intersect each other, [and] the illuminated segment is towards

lines.text: ارض میل کند و لحظه بلحظه متزاید شود تا بحدیکه از یکجانب ماه که محاذی افتابست نمایان
lines.en: the earth inclines and increases moment by moment until the extent that from one side of the moon which is opposite the sun, it becomes visible.

lines.text: شود و ان هلال باشد و اهل اینفن وقت رسیدن قمر را بحد رؤیت هلال موقوف بدو شرط
lines.en: And that is the crescent. And the people of this art consider the time of the moon reaching the limit of the sighting of the crescent to be dependent on two conditions.

lines.text: دانند که یافت شود در دو بعد که یکی را بعد معدل و حکم بلندی و پستی هلال و کثرت
lines.en: They know that it is found in two distances, one of which is the equatorial distance, and the judgment of the height and lowness of the crescent and the abundance

lines.text: و قلت مکث او فوق الافق از ان کنند و دیگر برا بعد سوار و شنی و تاریکی هلالی را
lines.en: and scarcity of its stay above the horizon they make from it. And the other is the distance of the rider and the slowness and darkness of the crescent

lines.text: از ان قیاس کنند لیکن در این دو شرط خلاف کرده اند انچه متعارف و متداولست نیست که معنو
lines.en: they deduce from it. But they have disagreed on these two conditions. What is customary and current is not that which is meant

summary.headline: Lunar Crescent Visibility
summary.text: Explanation of lunar crescent visibility: the Moon’s reflected sunlight, the circles of light and darkness and of vision, their changing relation after conjunction, and the two distances used to judge the crescent’s height, duration, slowness, and darkness. Authorities cited are Euclid’s Optics and the Conics, specifically Marjiʿ al-Tabrīn.
